description: Draw the trend you read out of mention_trend. Free, and makes no requests — it renders what you pass it: the series as a chart, per-network lines where you supply them, and your own read of what changed. Pass `tooShort` when the series has too few points to call a direction, and `edgeIsRecordStart` when the left edge is where the record begins rather than where the conversation did — a chart that hides either is the one mistake this view can make on your behalf. Call this after you have decided what the numbers mean. Figures are checked against what nooticr returned in this session: its own numbers are drawn, and a row it never returned is drawn marked as unchecked, so there is no need to re-type them exactly.

edgeIsRecordStart.description: True when the earliest point is the start of the kept record or the watch's own age, not the start of the conversation. Marks the left edge so a flat start is not read as silence.

metric.description: Which number the chart plots: "found" (default), "reported" or "medianViews".

points.description: The series, oldest first or newest first as you like — the same shape mention_trend returned (ranAt, found, reported, perPlatform, medianViews).

tooShort.description: True when there are too few points to call a direction. Drawn as a stated caveat rather than a trend line, because two points of scraped data are mostly the scrape.

verdict.description: Your read of what changed, in a sentence or two.

name: show_trend

edgeIsRecordStart.description: The left edge is the record's start, not the conversation's.

tooShort.description: Too few points to call a direction.

trend.description: The discriminator the view keys on.

status.description: verified: every row matched what nooticr returned this session. unverified: some are as re-sent.

unmatched.description: Rows not among what nooticr returned in this session; drawn as sent, unchecked.
